violation_type.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Central Sleeping Location (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Central Sleeping Location
violation_type.typical_finding: Observed a caregiver standing in a doorway of two classrooms while the children were sleeping, One classroom had 15 children and the other classroom had 14 children. The children were not combined in a centralized location. This was corrected when another teacher came into the classroom.

finding_variants.text: Observed a caregiver standing in a doorway of two classrooms while the children were sleeping, One classroom had 15 children and the other classroom had 14 children. The children were not combined in a centralized location. This was corrected when another teacher came into the classroom.
Nap time observed with children seperated into two classroom areas not in a centralized area and one caregiver supervising both classes.
The toddlers and two year olds were in two separate rooms during nap time with one care giver.      The children were combined to one central location.
This standard was found to be out of compliance. There were 4 infants ages 15 - 16 months combined with 11 two-year old children  and one caregiver during nap time.
